title: LuckRead D1-05 Shared Schema Runner Independent Review

review.description: Independent read-only review of W11-only D1-05 analytics ownership, four D1 source migrations, the PostgreSQL 18 schema baseline, privacy minimization, source-generator determinism and the shared runner's local-only restriction. This review is not remote DDL admission.

privacyBoundary.creatorIdPurpose: Existing analytics dimension admitted by the D1 schema; retention, deletion and consent/purpose rules remain missing and block remote admission.

reviewChecks: D1-05 is the canonical W11-exclusive analytics-only domain and retains the existing physical UUID.
W11 Wrangler retains exactly its pre-existing D1_05 binding to allluck and does not acquire a D1_03 binding.
The D1-05 shared manifest contains exactly one W11 PostgreSQL baseline migration and maps all four existing W11 D1 source migrations to that baseline.
The final PostgreSQL schema contains exactly six analytics tables, eight explicit indexes, zero foreign keys, zero triggers, zero trigger functions and zero control seed rows.
The SQL artifact does not create Campaign or GrowthOperation tables; those remain W11 logical D1-03 owners only.
No actor_id, visitor_id or session_id is persisted; actor_type and creator_id remain constrained by the current schema contract.
All 15 timestamp/hour text columns use PostgreSQL COLLATE C to preserve source SQLite BINARY ordering.
W01/W03 content telemetry and W05 authoritative social-event source ownership remain enforced by the source schema constraints.
The generator pins all four D1 migration Git blob SHA-1 values and the committed PostgreSQL artifact is deterministic.
The shared runner continues to reject remote Neon execution and accepts only an exact local PostgreSQL 18 database.
remoteApplyBlockers: Retention policy for each analytics event and derived aggregate class, including bounded late-event replay horizon, is missing.
Deletion/privacy-request behavior for actor-linked and creator-linked analytics projections is missing.
Consent, lawful purpose and collection eligibility rules for anonymous and authenticated telemetry are missing.
A separate reviewed remote runner release record and domain-specific remote schema approval are still required.
